notes.title: Finally, the update is here!
notes.content:
Added a Morale System to Campaigns
Adjusted the damage formula during battles; please refer to the in-battle tutorial for details
Added a Health Bar Mechanic for Bosses (each time a health bar is depleted, the Boss will gain a random enhancement effect)
Added a Resurrection Skill for Clerics, and added an Armor-Destroying trait to the Armor Shatter skill
Added damage display in battles, showing attack/defense damage percentages and estimated values
Fixed the issue where "Hero's Certificate" was incorrectly consumed when unlocking skins
Adjusted the Hero Selection Interface at the start of Campaigns; added a Random Selection Mechanic (updates daily)
Enhanced the effectiveness of Recovery-type Skills
Fixed the occasional issue where items could not be crafted in the Item Crafting system
Adjusted Legendary Equipment settings to prevent loss if picked up by enemies
Adjusted the effects of certain Item Affixes/Stat Entries
Enhanced the performance of Crossbows (Note: The original term "驽弓" is corrected to "弩弓" [crossbow], a type of ranged weapon)
Added a Shield Diminishment Effect (a mechanism where shield value decreases gradually over time or with each hit taken)
Added new dialogues for Murong Xuan (Murong Xuan is a character name, transliterated)
Added a new Boss (Sword Spirit · Furious Gale) to Floor 35 of the Abyss Dungeon ("Sword Spirit · Furious Gale" is the Boss name, retained as is)
Adjusted skills for the Summoner, Cleric, and Bishop classes
Fixed the issue where the Combined Skill could not be triggered when the Strategist was in a specific position
Adjusted skills for characters Xia Jing, Qi Yin, and Wang Xia (names are transliterated)
Optimized certain user interfaces
Updated limited-time events
Other optimizations and adjustments

notes.title: Repair and update
notes.content:
Xiaoyi small wood portrait replaced
Added Xiaoyi recruitment event
Lu Junyi passively adjusted
Sushan Future, Qinglong Glaive Knife, Reincarnation Stone Equipment Repair
The campaign removes equipment restrictions, and increases the penalty of a certain attribute bonus when recommending equipment if it is not equipped with the corresponding class, see the in-game beginner's tutorial for specific effects
Added the equipment decomposition function in the management interface
Added that units that were persuaded to surrender would retain their original random stat data, and fixed the random stat values of tavern recruited units
Fixed an issue where vampires could not be selected when killed as bats and auto-killed
Adjusted the number of items in the Campaign Item Shop to be purchased by clicking on them continuously, fixed the issue of duplicate purchases in the Equipment Shop, and fixed the display issue of the Item Shop
Fixed the issue of freezing status display
A new batch of random passives has been added
Bounty missions are adjusted to refresh as long as you complete any seven missions, removing the time limit and increasing the adventurer's level rewards
The logistics team and the adventure team have been adjusted, all heroes are shared, and heroes can only participate in one team
Dungeon dungeons add new mode of adventure party challenges and adjust the rewards for each mode
Add all Legacy Equipment to an Epic Form, which can be obtained randomly in the in-game through the Shop or Events
Skill Adjustment Fix: Dragon Goes to Sea, Dance of Swords, Demon Breaker, Heroic Fireball, Punishment Aura, Magic Shield, Guardian Circle, Preparation, Block, Shield Defense, Discord State
Fixed an issue with the display of dungeons when selecting an ally after they died
Fixed an issue where a disconnected unit could get stuck in settlement when it was killed
Removed the dungeon armor equipment attribute penalty, and adjusted the campaign mode non-recommended equipment attribute penalty to reduce damage avoidance by 10% and movement power -1
Enemy hero units can be added to the dungeon to obtain a random type of armor equipment
Dungeon Chests and Adventure Chests have increased the content of openings
Fixed a price issue caused by the selection of equipment for the Campaign Hire character
Added Blacksmith Adventurer Equipment Crafting, where players can craft randomly generated artifact equipment
The exchange adjusts, and the price fluctuation adjustment changes every 1 minute
The campaign adds that the protagonist can choose between a second active and passive
Added new item artifact crates, and adventurer-related item Medal of Glory
Added Adventurer's Guild to receive Adventurer Rewards, which can be redeemed for Adventurer Rewards
Some item materials have been modified
The Mystery Shop adds a supply function for adventurers
Tweaked enemy hero units to come with their own recovery items
Adjusted the dungeon boss to challenge the Relic Altar, and the minimum number of pieces of equipment that can be spawned at a time is 15 pieces to meet the initial selection
Fixed some audio bugs
Adventure team, logistics department selected character display fixed
Fixed the issue of time expiration
Warrior's passive damage skill increases damage, and the passive introduction has been modified
Summoned enhanced passive effect fix
